simple.meaning: בִּכּוּר (bikkûwr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the first-fruits of the crop.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 23:16. The surrounding context includes offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּכּוּר (H1061) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: בִּכּוּר (bikkûwr) / H1061 is traced through Exodus 23:16, Exodus 23:19, Exodus 34:22, Exodus 34:26 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God.
“You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
“You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God.
“ ‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
“ ‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah‡ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.
The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
“ ‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. He said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs: if they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

definitions.full: H1061. bikkurim בִּכּוּרִים noun masculine first-fruits — Lev 2:14 ; 23:17 ; Num 28:26 (P) 2Kin 4:42 ; Neh 3:12 ; 13:31 ; בִּכֻּרִים Lev 23:20 (P); construct בִּכּוּרֵי Exod 23:16 , 19 (E) 34:22 , 26 (J) Num 13:20 (E) 18:13 (P) Neh 10:36 (twice in verse); Ezek 44:30 ; suffix בִּכּוּרֶיךָ Lev 2:14 ; — the first of grain and ftuit that ripened and was gathered and offered to God according to the ritual; הַבִּכּוּרִים לֶחֶם bread made of the new grain offered at Pentecost 23:20 ; הבכורים יום day of the first-fruits (Pentecost) Num 28:26 . בַּל see below בלה . בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר בֵּל, see below בעל , p. 128.
